## What

A program on the KV260's ARM cores that replays the B1.2 data set into the
module's storage at the budgeted rate, as if the camera were producing it. These
replayed passes stand in for the camera until it arrives in B3.3, so build them
to last.

## Done when

- [ ] A 2-minute replay at the budgeted rate with **zero dropped frames**.
- [ ] Drops are counted, not assumed: every frame carries a sequence number and
      the loader reports any gap.
- [ ] The achieved rate and CPU load are logged.

## Notes

- Write it as a library from the start, even if only one script calls it today.
  B2.1 turns it into the API the camera will sit behind.
- Measure the storage write speed on its own first. If the storage cannot keep
  up with the rate, that is a B1.4 finding, not a loader bug.
